title: Step 1 — Content-addressed objects
body:
# Step 1 — Content-addressed objects

Implement `blobstore.objects` according to the local architecture contract.
Provide `ObjectStore(root)`, `put_bytes`, `put_stream`, `get`, `exists`,
`verify`, and `iter_ids`, plus explicit corruption and invalid-ID errors.
Use SHA-256 sharded paths and atomic durable publication. Existing corrupt
content must be reported, never silently replaced. Reads and verification are
read-only. Do not implement later subsystems.
